actions.name: Crush
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the darkmantle had Advantage on the attack roll, it covers the target, which has the Blinded condition and is suffocating while the darkmantle is attached in this way. While attached to a target, the darkmantle can attack only the target but has Advantage on its attack rolls. Its Speed becomes 0, it can’t benefit from any bonus to its Speed, and it moves with the target. A creature can take an action to try to detach the darkmantle from itself, doing so with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Darkness Aura (1/Day)
actions.desc: Magical Darkness fills a 15-foot

actions.name: Emanation originating from the darkmantle
actions.desc: This effect lasts while the darkmantle maintains Concentration on it, up to 10 minutes. Darkvision can’t penetrate this area, and no light can illuminate it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The death dog makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. First Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target’s Hit Point maximum doesn’t return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and it repeats the save every 24 hours that elapse, ending the effect on itself on a success. Subsequent Failures: The Poisoned target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10).

special_abilities.name: Exalted Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If the deva dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The deva has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The deva makes two Holy Mace attacks.

actions.name: Holy Mace
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc: The deva casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

actions.name: At Will
actions.desc: Detect Evil and Good, Shapechange (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell)

actions.name: 1/Day Each
actions.desc: Commune, Raise Dead

bonus_actions.name: Divine Aid (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The deva casts Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

special_abilities.name: Elemental Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If the djinni dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Air.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The djinni has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Wishes
special_abilities.desc: The djinni has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the djinni knows it, the djinni can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the djinni can understand. If the djinni casts the spell for the creature, the djinni suffers none of the spell’s stress. Once the djinni has cast it three times, the djinni can’t do so again for 365 days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The djinni makes three attacks, using Storm Blade or Storm Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Storm Blade
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 feet. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Storm Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 feet. Hit: 13 (3d8) Thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Create Whirlwind
actions.desc: The djinni conjures a whirlwind at a point it can see within 120 feet. The whirlwind fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Cylinder centered on that point. The whirlwind lasts until the djinni’s Concentration on it ends. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns. Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature’s space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17 (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the djinni is unaffected). Failure: While in the whirlwind, the target has the Restrained condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target takes 21 (6d6) Thunder damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc: The djinni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

actions.name: At Will
actions.desc: Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic

actions.name: 2/Day Each
actions.desc: Create Food and Water (can create wine instead of water), Tongues, Wind Walk

actions.name: 1/Day Each
actions.desc: Creation, Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The doppelganger makes two Slam attacks and uses Unsettling Visage if available.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6 (with Advantage during the first round of each combat), reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Read Thoughts
actions.desc: The doppelganger casts Detect Thoughts, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).

actions.name: Unsettling Visage (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the doppelganger that can see the doppelganger. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.desc: The doppelganger shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes three Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 15 ft. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Being underwater doesn’t grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 15 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Steam Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 56 (16d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: Being underwater doesn’t grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Fetid Cloud (1/Day)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the dretch. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned, the creature can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both, and it can’t take Reactions.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the drider has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

special_abilities.name: Web Walker
special_abilities.desc: The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the drider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The drider makes three attacks, using Foreleg or Poison Burst in any combination.

actions.name: Foreleg
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Poison Burst
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Magic of the Spider Queen (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: The drider casts Darkness, Faerie Fire, or Web, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The druid makes two attacks, using Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp in any combination.

actions.name: Vine Staff
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Verdant Wisp
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 90 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc: The druid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

actions.name: At Will
actions.desc: Druidcraft, Speak with Animals

actions.name: 2/Day Each
actions.desc: Entangle, Thunderwave

actions.name: 1/Day Each
actions.desc: Animal Messenger, Longstrider, Moonbeam

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The dryad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
special_abilities.desc: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dryad makes one Vine Lash or Thorn Burst attack, and it can use Spellcasting to cast Charm Monster.

actions.name: Vine Lash
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Thorn Burst
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc: The dryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

actions.name: At Will
actions.desc: Animal Friendship, Charm Monster (lasts 24 hours; ends early if the dryad casts the spell again), Druidcraft

actions.name: 1/Day Each
actions.desc: Entangle, Pass without Trace

bonus_actions.name: Tree Stride
bonus_actions.desc: If within 5 feet of a Large or bigger tree, the dryad teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a second Large or bigger tree that is within 60 feet of the previous tree.

special_abilities.name: Death Burst
special_abilities.desc: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot

special_abilities.name: Emanation originating from the mephit
special_abilities.desc: Failure: 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Blinding Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mephit’s next turn.

actions.name: Sleep (1/Day)
actions.desc: The mephit casts the Sleep spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 10).

special_abilities.name: Agile
special_abilities.desc: The deer doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it moves out of an enemy’s reach.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: The wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.
